course_name_original: Python for Scientific Computations and Control
course_name_en: Python for Scientific Computations and Control
syllabus_topics: Getting acquainted with the Python environment: Installation, IDEs, basic syntax, data types, functions.
Python and object-oriented programming: classes and objects, methods, attributes, inheritance, polymorphism, magic methods.
Python for scientific computing using the NumPy, SciPy libraries - linear algebra, solving differential equations. Time series visualization using the Matplotlib library.
Working with data using the Pandas library: Loading data from a file, preprocessing, data operations such as sorting, filtering, basic statistics.
Introduction to artificial intelligence (genetic algorithms, fuzzy systems, perceptron).
Artificial intelligence using the TensorFlow library - neural networks (MLP, convolutional neural networks, self-organizing maps).
Fundamentals of web application development: Databases, requests, API.
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
